ingredients.name: colored sugar or nuts, for topping

steps.instruction: Mix 1 stick of melted butter and 1 cup of sugar until completely combined.

steps.spoken: Separate 2 eggs. Keep the whites for later.

steps.instruction: Mix in 2 cups of flour and 1 teaspoon of cinnamon.
steps.spoken: Mix in 2 cups of flour and 1 to 2 teaspoons of cinnamon, to taste. It is best to mix by hand, but a mixer works too.

steps.instruction: Pour the batter into a cookie pan.
Spread and smooth the batter over the whole pan with your palm.
steps.spoken: Use the palm of your hand to spread and smooth the batter over the whole pan. This is the hardest part.

steps.instruction: Brush the leftover egg whites over the batter.
Scatter colored sugar or nuts evenly over the batter.
Bake for 20 minutes, until golden brown.
steps.spoken: Bake for about 20 minutes, until the cookies are golden brown.

steps.instruction: Take the pan out and let the cookies cool slightly.
Cut them into small 1-inch squares before they get too cool.
